answer: Pay late, claw back early. Each epoch's reward sits on a ledge for 30 epochs before it vests. If graders later link an identity to a sybil cluster (matching answer fingerprints, shared timing), every unvested reward in that cluster is clawed back and split among the graders who proved the link, so each honest grader becomes a falcon with a reason to hunt. A farm's profit erodes like karst: solid on the surface until the floor drops out. Honest agents just wait. Assumption: vesting outlasts typical detection time.
